title: Traffic Engineering  Fall 2026
text:
Syllabus: Course Description

This course (ECIV 542) is designed to teach students the fundamentals of traffic engineering.
This course will enable students to solve transportation problems that are likely to appear in FE/PE exam and professional practice.
Serve as a foundation for graduate coursework at USC or other academic institutions.

Syllabus: Class Attendance

You are expected to attend all lectures and labs and contribute to the team’s class project.

title: Traffic Engineering  Fall 2026
text:
Syllabus: Class Documents
All class documents will be made available on Blackboard. The instructor will provide supplemental notes. It is the student’s responsibility to check Blackboard and print the provided documents.

title: Traffic Engineering  Fall 2026
text:
Syllabus: Class Project

Students will work in groups of 3-6 to conduct traffic analyses of intersections near campus.
Each team will be assigned to one intersection (randomly).
Each team will be responsible for collecting its own data, performing appropriate analyses, and making recommendations.

There will be a final report, and if time permits, each team will make a presentation to the class describing their work.
